sources.locator: 259 files in the ignored fixture tree: 259 mods classified as mod-jar input artifacts, 0 shaderpacks; loaded mod-container count is unmeasured
sources.use: 254 CDN reference jars plus five publisher-bundled override jars. Artifact-set digest is SHA256 of mod TAB filename TAB lowercase SHA256 LF records, filename-sorted, matching the existing artifact-set row encoding. Reference/bundled/runtime counts stay separate; nested/game/runtime jars are not input artifacts in this set. Jar legal metadata and dependency declarations may be read; class method bodies are not decompiled or disassembled.

rights.json has the ATM10 rights-triage shape: per-input licence family, surface statuses, source use and publication verdicts. rights-evidence.json, keyed by graph node id, holds the jar-level legal-metadata digests, cfwidget responses, and for every input whose jar declares no licence the source-repository LICENSE or README citation (repository, tag or commit, path, SHA-256), the Modrinth exact-file licence where used, or the search trail behind an absent finding. 163 of the 235 jar-undeclared inputs resolved to a cited grant; 72 remain absent. Pack licensing is not inherited by its mods.
sources.producedBy: WP0 local publisher acquisition plus a repository licence resolution pass (GitHub REST API, Modrinth API)

sources.use: Declared dependencies from mcmod.info and class-level Forge @Mod annotations. graph.json has the ATM10 dependency-graph shape; graph-evidence.json holds an index-aligned declaration source (mcmod.info entry or annotation attribute, named by artifact filename) for every graph edge, the three wildcard ordering declarations excluded from the graph, and per-jar declaration records. Class bytes were opened for constant pools and annotation attributes only; method bodies were skipped by attribute length, not decompiled, disassembled or interpreted. The graph conservatively declares restrictedContentRead true for this binary access. Metadata-only describes the evidence used, not an assertion that no class bytes were opened. Missing sources, nested inputs, invalid strict JSON and no-declared-dependency jars are explicit in the evidence. Identity presence is not version compatibility or runtime load success.
Official Mojang metadata, client and server bytes, publisher SHA1 and locally recomputed SHA256. Mojang Java 8 baseline is distinct from the pinned JDK27 execution target; no live launch is claimed.
